root_cause.text: The `download_firmware` function in the Bluetooth `hci_ll` driver fails to release the allocated firmware resource via `release_firmware()` when `request_firmware()` succeeds but returns invalid firmware data or size.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that inside `download_firmware()`, when the condition `if (err || !fw->data || !fw->size)` is met, the code is updated to call `release_firmware(fw)` if `err` is false (i.e., `!err`), preventing a resource leak before returning `-EINVAL`.
